name: Empty Cells
canDoWhy: A Windhelm guard brings you a message, then the Steward of Windhelm asks you to look into vampires under the city.

starts.who: A Windhelm guard acting as a courier, then the Steward
starts.where: Windhelm; the Steward sandboxes in the Palace of the Kings once the quest is over
starts.how: Talk to the guard who brings the message, then to the Steward. He greets you with "Welcome, I've been expecting you. I heard about the incident at the Temple of Stendarr..."

firstStep: Talk to the Windhelm guard who has a message for you

objectives: Talk to the courier (a Windhelm guard)
Ask the Steward about the Maiden Statue
Look for the Windhelm Report in the Temple of Stendarr

people.name: Steward
people.role: Steward of Windhelm, who sets the investigation; essential

people.name: Windhelm Guard
people.role: the courier who brings you to the Steward

people.name: Gwyneth
people.role: Vigilant librarian at the Temple of Stendarr; has lines early in the quest

people.name: Facis
people.role: a vampire merchant found in Matron's Chamber; essential

unsure.why: Nothing in these files says what sends the courier. The Steward mentions 'the incident at the Temple of Stendarr' and his faction marks him as part of Vigilant's second act, so it probably follows the first act (The Landing / Art of Mercy). Not confirmed.

The Steward is placed in a holding cell and moved in by script. During the quest he only has a 'wait' package with no place; after it he sandboxes in the Palace of the Kings. Where the guard finds you isn't in these files.

The objectives only say 'Windhelm dungeons' and 'under Windhelm'. Which cells those are (Old Sewers, Bloody Well, Asylum, Enchantress' Palace, Matron's Chamber hold the act's vampires) is inferred, not stated. The records give the Temple of Stendarr no hold.
The quest script has a Gold property; the amount and the exact moment you get it aren't in these files.
Inferred from the mod's quest order and the shared vampire lairs; no record link to Remnants was found.
Besides the normal finish, the quest has two more end stages with no journal text. They are probably fail/shutdown stages, but that isn't certain.

evidence: alias Courier = Windhelm Guard; alias Steward = Vigilant.esm:4B2C91
PACK zzzBMMq01StewardWait (GetQuestRunning) and zzzBMM01StweardSandbox at Skyrim.esm:01677C Palace of the Kings (GetQuestCompleted)

canDoWhy: Find Lamae Beolfag in Matron's Chamber and face Lamae Bal, the Blood Matron cursed by Molag Bal.

starts.where: Matron's Chamber, where she lies asleep
starts.how: Speak with Lamae Beolfag; Molag Bal and Lamae Bal speak to you later in the quest.

firstStep: Find Lamae Beolfag in Matron's Chamber

takesYou.why: find Lamae and face Molag Bal

choices.choice: How the curse ends (the records show two separate endings)
choices.leadsTo: unclear from these files; see unsure

objectives: Free Lamae Bal from the curse of Molag Bal

people.name: Lamae Beolfag
people.role: Vigilant of Stendarr, asleep in Matron's Chamber; first to speak

people.name: Molag Bal
people.role: appears in Matron's Chamber

people.name: Lamae Bal
people.role: the Blood Matron; fought in Lamae's Dream and as an undead in Matron's Chamber

people.name: Blood Curse of Molag Bal
people.role: in Matron's Chamber; essential

unsure.why: Inferred from the mod's quest order (it comes after Remnants); no record link was found.
Matron's Chamber has no hold or parent town in the records. It is likely under Windhelm with the other lairs, but that isn't stated.

The quest can complete at two different points: one after the main objectives, one at the end of a separate run of stages. That suggests two endings, but the records have no text saying what they are.

The script holds Lamae's Kin (as 'AbBloodofLamae') and Fire Storm (Weak) (as 'StandUpSpell'). In other Vigilant quests Lamae's Kin is a blood curse, so it may be given or taken away here rather than earned. Fire Storm looks like a scripted effect. Neither is listed as a sure reward.
